messages.content: 你能幫我找到加州洛杉磯的素食餐廳嗎？它們至少要營業到晚上10點，然後也幫我找一下加州舊金山和華盛頓州西雅圖的素食餐廳嗎？

function.name: vegan_restaurant_find_nearby
function.description: Locate nearby vegan restaurants based on specific criteria like operating hours. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY

operating_hours.description: Preferred latest closing time of the restaurant. E.g. if 11 is given, then restaurants that close at or after 11 PM will be considered. This is in 24 hour format.

message.reasoning:
The user wants vegan restaurants in Los Angeles (California) that stay open until at least 10pm. Also want vegan restaurants in San Francisco (California) and Seattle (Washington). They didn't specify operating hours for SF and Seattle; maybe we can use default 9pm? But they only specified requirement for LA. We should ask clarifying question about operating hours for SF and Seattle. Or we could assume default 9pm. But better to clarify.

We need to call function vegan_restaurant_find_nearby with location "Los Angeles, CA" and operating_hours=22. Then also find for San Francisco, CA and Seattle, WA. For those we might not set operating_hours param, so it defaults to 21. That matches default. So we can do separate calls for each location. Probably best to make three calls: one for LA with operating_hours=22, one for SF without specifying operating_hours, one for Seattle without specifying. We'll return results.
